class.name: Vector2Spreener
class.brief_description: Interpolates an [Object]'s [Vector2] property based on the damping ratio and halflife of a spring.
class.description: [Vector2Spreener] is used to interpolate a [Vector2] property of an object. See [method Spreen.spreen_vector2]. [b]Note:[/b] [method Spreen.spreen_vector2] is the only correct way to create [Vector2Spreener]. Any [Vector2Spreener] created manually will not function correctly.

method.name: update_goal
method.description: Updates the goal of the [Vector2Spreener] in real time. When used in tandem with [method Spreen.set_finishable] can be used to dampen noisy inputs.
